text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Head of state debt department of the Finance Ministry, Gao Jian, says China will allow the establishment of state debt mutual investment funds as soon as possible.
- Editorial warns about the risks of investing on the stock markets following the bull run of the past few weeks.
- China's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is expected to hit more than eight trillion yuan this year.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Shanghai needs to expand industries producing key raw materials.
- Commentary says China must clean up smuggled car market.
